description: Telemetry sink admin (D22): mint ONE per-(runId, role) ingest token SEALED to the role's services x25519 public key. Output is {runId, role, tokenId, sealed} only: sealTo is required and the output filter refuses anything carrying a plaintext token or a non-object sealed box. tokenId is the sha256 digest (public identifier) used for reconciliation. Sink admin only (role clockchain-telemetry-sink-admin).

runId.description: Run id from the harness plan

sealTo.description: 0x + 64 lowercase hex: the role's services x25519 PUBLIC key (services-pub.txt on that role's host)

runCommand: OUT=$(docker exec "$CID" node dist/mint-cli.js ingest --runId '{{runId}}' --role '{{role}}' --seal-to '{{sealTo}}') || { echo 'mint refused (see stderr)' >&2; exit 65; }

printf '%s' "$OUT" | docker exec -i "$CID" node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{let o;try{o=JSON.parse(s)}catch{console.error("refused: mint output is not JSON");process.exit(66)}const r=o&&o.record;const sealed=o&&o.sealed;if(!o||typeof o!=="object"||"token" in o||!sealed||typeof sealed!=="object"||Array.isArray(sealed)||!r||r.kind!=="ingest"||r.runId!==process.argv[1]||r.role!==process.argv[2]){console.error("refused: not a sealed-only ingest mint for this runId/role");process.exit(66)}console.log(JSON.stringify({runId:r.runId,role:r.role,tokenId:r.tokenId,sealed}))})' '{{runId}}' '{{role}}'
